name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
tagline: Best-in-class Indian engineering & construction conglomerate with a Rs 5.2 lakh Cr order book - a quality compounder, but at ~Rs 5.6 lakh Cr market cap there is no 10x/2-3yr or 100x/10yr slope
business_overview: Larsen & Toubro is India's largest engineering, procurement and construction company, spanning infrastructure projects, heavy engineering, defence, hydrocarbons, power transmission & distribution, renewables, water, and a large IT services cluster (LTIMindtree, LTTS) plus financial services. Order book was over Rs 5.2 lakh crore as of Q3 FY26.
fundamentals_table: Q4 FY26 revenue +11.25% YoY; consolidated net profit ~ -3% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: High-quality, well-diversified and executing well, with a record order book and above-trend revenue growth. But it is a ~Rs 5.6 lakh crore mega-cap - a 10x in 2-3 years would imply a ~Rs 55 lakh crore valuation, and 100x in 10 years is not meaningful at this scale.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Near record highs; market cap crossed Rs 3 trillion in 2022 and has continued higher.
